repos_data.description: Free Zip / Unzip software and Rar file extractor. Cross-platform file and archive manager. Features volume spanning, compression, authenticated encryption. Supports 7Z, 7-Zip sfx, ACE, ARJ, Brotli, BZ2, CAB, CHM, CPIO, DEB, GZ, ISO, JAR, LHA/LZH, NSIS, OOo, PAQ/LPAQ, PEA, QUAD, RAR, RPM, split, TAR, Z, ZIP, ZIPX, Zstandard.
A C++ static library offering a clean and simple interface to the 7-zip shared libraries.
Archive manager and 7zip replacement for macOS. Preview (nested) archives without extracting them. Extract single files.
Go bindings for unarr (decompression library for RAR, TAR, ZIP and 7z archives)

UnifiedArchive - an archive manager with unified interface for different formats (bundled with cli utility). Supports all formats with basic operations (reading, extracting and creation) and popular formats specific features (compression level, password-protection, comment)
A Single Library Parser to extract meta information,static analysis and detect macros within the files.
